meta.name: Restart Thread — Forward Thread
meta.source: forward-thread-prototype.png plus accepted Run 8 H2 and I2-V1 specifications
meta.notes: Values marked reconstructed are starting values inferred from the static board and require rendered-device validation.

rules.singleAccentMeaning: Red means user-controlled action, selection, trace, or focus; errors require a separate icon and label.
rules.primaryEmphasis: One filled red action per decision context.
rules.increasedContrast: Required but not numerically defined by the prototype; derive and remeasure every rendered pair.

display.value: platform serif or verified licensed editorial serif
display.confidence: visual category observed; exact family unknown

interfaceAndroid.value: Roboto or active Android system sans

primaryAction.ambientShadow: soft dark halo behind a crisp colored contact edge
primaryAction.topHighlight: one restrained top-edge highlight; no glass or gloss

motion.traceBack: single direct dotted connector reveal; no spring
motion.reducedMotion: static final connector or short opacity crossfade

sensory.primaryActionHaptic: platform confirmation cue after accepted activation; optional and never the only feedback
sensory.durableSaveHaptic: discrete system success cue only after the local file commit
sensory.optionalSaveSound: one dry soft page tap with no loop or reverb; respect silent and Do Not Disturb
sensory.recording: no custom sound or continuous haptic while the microphone is active
